Fantastic pet shop and pet care in Ilkley from Tyler-James.  Such nice guys, and Luke, nicknamed by me as The Cat Fairy as he's magical, comes in to look after my furry friend, Tosca, my gorgeous cat I got four years ago from Keighley Cat Care when I'm away.  Luke adores her. Friends in Ilkley have just bought her a £15 voucher to spend in there as they too love the place. Highly recommend and long may it last.
